Subject: Buying critical path & Chair brief: next steps

Martin — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum for Greenline's evaluation.

Key stakeholders we captured on the call:
- Economic / Exec sponsor: Martin Lowe (you)
- Security: Anita Shah (Head of InfoSec)
- Procurement: Rajiv Patel (vendor contracts)
- Legal: Sofia Miller (external counsel)
- Product/Integration owner: Priya Rao (Greenline) — introduced briefly

Decision criteria you mentioned:
- Data handling & retention controls (must pass internal risk review)
- Latency / availability for peak retail hours (holiday load)
- Unit economics / per-token cost target
- Ability to isolate data in VPC/private deployment for regulated flows

Open asks / actions we need from your side:
1) Can you confirm who would chair the steering committee (exec sponsor or designee)? we want to align the agenda to that person’s priorities.
2) Procurement timeline & gating steps (SOW, PO, legal redlines). If Rajiv has a standard timeline template, please share.
3) Security pre-reads required for your team: do you want a SOC 2 report, DPA draft, penetration test summary, or all three?

From our side we will:
- Draft a 1-page Chair Brief for exec review (30–45s to read) — Ben will own commercial highlights.
- Produce a 1-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with dates and owners.
- Share relevant security artifacts and our standard DPA for initial legal review.

Proposed steering committee chair briefing (15–20 min):
- Current scope & what success looks like for Greenline
- Risk & mitigations (security, compliance)
- Commercial principles and milestones
- Rollout timeline & decision gates

If possible please: confirm chair & procurement lead this week and share any hard dates you have for final decision (target windows you mentioned were mid-November -> late-November). I’ll assemble the chair brief + MAP and circulate.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Rachel — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

2) Procurement timeline (high level):
- Week of Nov 8: internal risk & security triage (Anita)
- Week of Nov 15: steering committee / exec briefing (tentative; exact date TBD)
- Nov 22–29: legal review and contract negotiation (Sofia will lead)
- Early Dec: expected PO issuance if all clear

3) Security artifacts: please share SOC 2 Type II (most recent), a DPA draft, and a summary of any external pentest results. Anita will run a checklist against those.

4) Commercial: Rajiv asked I get a rough pricing range before the steering meeting so procurement can validate budget bands. A ballpark within 20% is fine for now.

We have a few constraints on steering committee timing: holiday planning team is out the week of Nov 22, so would prefer week of Nov 15. I can do Tue Nov 16 or Thu Nov 18 mid-morning PT. If you could send a chair brief and MAP by Thursday (Nov 5) midday, that will help us prep.
